_comment: Plan T4.0 — the NEWS-PERSON identity namespace, human-owned. A news_person_id is opaque and immutable (np_<8 hex>); it survives spelling changes and is never a main-site Postgres id (those are positional ordinals reassigned on every resolve). The main-site link is OPTIONAL (`verified_main_site_slug`) — prominent news actors include private individuals, witnesses and suspects with no official profile, and manufacturing one for them is inappropriate. A record resolves mentions only while `status` is active AND through aliases with `status` accepted; every accepted alias carries evidence URLs, a scope, a reviewer and a time. A SURNAME-ONLY alias may never be global (a surname collides inside one case: Ивайло and Георги Калушев); an ambiguous full name (three Огнян Атанасов in the corpus) resolves only inside a scope, and case membership is supporting context, not proof — so the case-scoped alias below stays pending until a reviewer accepts it. `disambiguation` describes SOURCED identity context and never culpability or a model's character judgment; it stays null when unsupported. Merges keep the retired id as a redirect in `retired_ids`; splits re-review every alias of the split record. The resolver (news_persons.py) — never the model — assigns an identity; unresolved names remain visible as unlinked, „not assessed“, and enter news/review/news_person_candidates.json.
